analysis.reasonEn: Five consecutive down days recently, with daily RSI at 36.7 entering oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from 331.3148 to -466.3145, indicating bearish convergence. ADX at 13.3 shows no trend formation, and the sharp decline suggests a potential shock-induced move. Weekly RSI is 43.0 in bearish territory, and weekly MACD histogram is also negative. Current price of 33,095 KRW is testing support near the lower Bollinger Band at 33,647 KRW. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 2.15, showing a surge, but trend reversal signals are weak, warranting a wait-and-see approach.
